summary: AES Corp filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a public offering of $600M 5.200% senior notes due 2029 and $400M 5.750% senior notes due 2033 under an existing shelf registration. The notes were priced at 99.946% and 99.740% of par, respectively. Proceeds will repay existing debt and for general corporate purposes. The underwriting syndicate includes J.P. Morgan, Wells Fargo, Citigroup, Goldman Sachs, and SMBC Nikko. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation. Watch for typical interest rate and credit risk; no special-situation angle.
